definitions.name: Fighter
definitions.summary: Master of weapons and armor, with more attacks than anyone.

definitions.name: Battle Master
definitions.summary: Tactician who fuels combat maneuvers with a pool of superiority dice.

definitions.name: Combat Superiority
definitions.summary: You know maneuvers (3, rising to 5/7/9 at 7th/10th/15th) fueled by superiority dice: four d8s, a fifth at 7th and sixth at 15th, all back on a short or long rest. Maneuver save DC is 8 + proficiency bonus + Strength or Dexterity modifier.

actions.name: Maneuver
actions.note: Spend a superiority die on one of your maneuvers (a few use your reaction or bonus action instead). Save DC 8 + PB + STR or DEX.

when.text: spend a superiority die on a damage maneuver (Trip, Pushing, Menacing...)

definitions.name: Student of War
definitions.summary: Proficiency with one type of artisan's tools of your choice.

definitions.name: Know Your Enemy
definitions.summary: Study a creature outside combat for 1 minute to learn whether it is your equal, superior or inferior in two characteristics of your choice (such as a score, AC, current HP, class levels).

definitions.name: Improved Combat Superiority
definitions.summary: Your superiority dice become d10s.

definitions.name: Relentless
definitions.summary: When you roll initiative with no superiority dice left, you regain one.

definitions.name: Improved Combat Superiority
definitions.summary: Your superiority dice become d12s.

definitions.name: Eldritch Knight
definitions.summary: Fighter who weaves wizard magic, mostly abjuration and evocation, into weapon play.

definitions.name: Spellcasting
definitions.summary: Third-caster using Intelligence and the wizard list. Cantrips: 2 (3 at 10th). Spells known: 3 at 3rd up to 13 at 20th; all but those learned at 3rd, 8th, 14th and 20th must be abjuration or evocation. Slots follow the Eldritch Knight table (one-third caster).

choices.label: Spells known (abjuration or evocation, except the free picks)

definitions.name: Weapon Bond
definitions.summary: A 1-hour ritual bonds you to up to two weapons: you can't be disarmed of a bonded weapon, and you can summon one to your hand as a bonus action.

actions.name: Summon bonded weapon
actions.note: A bonded weapon on the same plane teleports to your hand.

definitions.name: War Magic
definitions.summary: When you use your action to cast a cantrip, you can make one weapon attack as a bonus action.

actions.name: War Magic attack
actions.note: After casting a cantrip with your action: one weapon attack.

definitions.name: Eldritch Strike
definitions.summary: A creature you hit with a weapon attack has disadvantage on the next saving throw it makes against a spell you cast before the end of your next turn.

modifiers.label: Eldritch Strike: the target has disadvantage on its next save against your spell before the end of your next turn.

definitions.name: Arcane Charge
definitions.summary: When you use Action Surge, you can also teleport up to 30 feet to a space you can see.

definitions.name: Improved War Magic
definitions.summary: When you use your action to cast a spell, you can make one weapon attack as a bonus action.

actions.name: Improved War Magic attack
actions.note: After casting any spell with your action: one weapon attack.

definitions.name: Arcane Archer
definitions.summary: Archer who weaves magic into arrows for a few powerful shots per rest.

definitions.name: Arcane Archer Lore
definitions.summary: Proficiency in Arcana or Nature, and you learn the Prestidigitation or Druidcraft cantrip.

definitions.name: Arcane Shot
definitions.summary: Twice per short or long rest, when a ranged weapon attack with an arrow hits, apply one Arcane Shot option you know (2 at 3rd; one more at 7th, 10th, 15th and 18th; extra damage grows at 18th). Save DC 8 + proficiency bonus + Intelligence modifier.

actions.name: Arcane Shot
actions.note: Once per turn, after a ranged arrow attack hits (Seeking Arrow is rolled in its place). DC 8 + PB + INT.

definitions.name: Magic Arrow
definitions.summary: Nonmagical arrows you fire become magical for overcoming resistance and immunity.

definitions.name: Curving Shot
definitions.summary: When a magic arrow you fire misses, you can use a bonus action to reroll the attack against another target within 60 feet of the first.

actions.name: Curving Shot
actions.note: After missing with a magic arrow: reroll the attack against a different target within 60 ft of the original.

definitions.name: Ever-Ready Shot
definitions.summary: When you roll initiative with no Arcane Shot uses left, you regain one.

definitions.name: Cavalier
definitions.summary: Mounted warrior and defender who marks foes and shields allies.

definitions.name: Bonus Proficiency
definitions.summary: One skill of your choice from Animal Handling, History, Insight, Performance or Persuasion (or a language instead).

definitions.name: Born to the Saddle
definitions.summary: Advantage on saves to avoid falling off your mount; you land on your feet after falling less than 10 feet from it; mounting or dismounting costs only 5 feet of movement.

definitions.name: Unwavering Mark
definitions.summary: A creature you hit in melee is marked until the end of your next turn: it has disadvantage on attacks that don't target you while you're within 5 feet. If it damages someone else, you can make a bonus-action melee attack against it with advantage, adding half your fighter level to the damage (Strength modifier uses per long rest, at least one).

actions.name: Unwavering Mark attack
actions.note: Your marked target damaged someone else: one melee weapon attack with advantage, + half fighter level damage.

when.text: bonus-action attack against your marked target
bonus-action attack against your marked target

definitions.name: Warding Maneuver
definitions.summary: Reaction when you or a creature within 5 feet is hit: add 1d8 to the target's AC against it; if it still hits, the target has resistance to its damage. Constitution modifier uses per long rest (at least one).

actions.name: Warding Maneuver
actions.note: Must be holding a melee weapon or shield. If the attack still hits, the target resists its damage.

definitions.name: Hold the Line
definitions.summary: Creatures provoke an opportunity attack from you when they move 5 feet or more within your reach; a hit with that attack reduces their speed to 0 for the rest of the turn.

definitions.name: Ferocious Charger
definitions.summary: Once per turn, after moving at least 10 feet in a straight line, a creature you hit must succeed on a Strength save (DC 8 + proficiency + Strength modifier) or be knocked prone.

modifiers.label: Ferocious Charger: after a 10-ft straight move, the target makes a STR save (DC 8 + PB + STR) or falls prone. Once per turn.

definitions.name: Vigilant Defender
definitions.summary: Once on every creature's turn other than your own, you can make an opportunity attack with a special reaction that doesn't use your normal reaction.

definitions.name: Samurai
definitions.summary: Resolute warrior whose fighting spirit drives relentless, accurate attacks.

definitions.name: Bonus Proficiency
definitions.summary: One skill of your choice from History, Insight, Performance or Persuasion (or a language instead).

definitions.name: Fighting Spirit
definitions.summary: Three times per long rest, as a bonus action: advantage on weapon attack rolls until the end of the turn and 5 temporary hit points (10 at 10th, 15 at 15th).

actions.name: Fighting Spirit
actions.note: Advantage on weapon attacks this turn, plus temporary hit points.

definitions.name: Elegant Courtier
definitions.summary: Add your Wisdom modifier to Charisma (Persuasion) checks, and gain proficiency in Wisdom saves (or Intelligence or Charisma saves if you already have it).

definitions.name: Tireless Spirit
definitions.summary: When you roll initiative with no Fighting Spirit uses left, you regain one.

definitions.name: Rapid Strike
definitions.summary: Once per turn, when you take the Attack action and have advantage on an attack against a creature, you can give up the advantage to make an extra weapon attack against it.

definitions.name: Strength before Death
definitions.summary: Once per long rest, when damage drops you to 0 hit points without killing you, use your reaction to take an extra turn right away, delaying falling unconscious until it ends.

actions.name: Strength before Death
actions.note: Dropped to 0 HP: take an extra turn now; damage on it still causes death save failures.

definitions.name: Psi Warrior
definitions.summary: Fighter who channels psionic energy into force strikes, telekinesis and protective fields.

definitions.name: Psionic Power
definitions.summary: Psionic Energy dice equal to twice your proficiency bonus (d6, growing to d12), back on a long rest; a bonus action regains one, once per short rest. Spend them on Protective Field (reaction: reduce damage by a die + Intelligence modifier) and Psionic Strike (once per turn on a hit: extra force damage of a die + Intelligence modifier). Telekinetic Movement is free once per short rest, or costs a die.

actions.name: Regain a Psionic Energy die
actions.note: Once per short or long rest.

actions.name: Protective Field
actions.note: You or a creature within 30 ft takes damage: reduce it by the roll.

actions.name: Psionic Strike
actions.note: Tick it on a weapon hit against a target within 30 ft: once per turn.

actions.name: Telekinetic Movement
actions.note: Move a Large or smaller loose object or willing creature within 30 ft up to 30 ft. Free once per short rest; afterwards spend a Psionic Energy die (use the die action).

when.text: spend a Psionic Energy die, target within 30 ft

definitions.name: Telekinetic Adept
definitions.summary: Psi-Powered Leap: bonus action, a flying speed of twice your walking speed this turn (free once per short rest, else a die). Telekinetic Thrust: when Psionic Strike deals damage, the target makes a Strength save or is knocked prone or pushed up to 10 feet.

actions.name: Psi-Powered Leap
actions.note: Fly speed of twice your walking speed until the end of the turn. Free once per short rest; afterwards spend a Psionic Energy die.

definitions.name: Guarded Mind
definitions.summary: Resistance to psychic damage; at the start of your turn, spend a Psionic Energy die to end every effect charming or frightening you.

actions.name: Guarded Mind
actions.note: Start of your turn: end all charmed and frightened effects on you.

definitions.name: Bulwark of Force
definitions.summary: Bonus action: up to your Intelligence modifier (min 1) creatures within 30 feet, you included, gain half cover for 1 minute or until you're incapacitated. Free once per long rest, else a die.

actions.name: Bulwark of Force
actions.note: Half cover (+2 AC and Dex saves) for chosen creatures for 1 minute. Free once per long rest; afterwards spend a Psionic Energy die.

definitions.name: Telekinetic Master
definitions.summary: You can cast Telekinesis (Intelligence) without components, free once per long rest or by spending a die; while concentrating on it, you can make one weapon attack as a bonus action each turn.

spells.name: Telekinesis
spells.casting: no slot or components; free once per long rest, else a Psionic Energy die

actions.name: Telekinetic Master attack
actions.note: While concentrating on Telekinesis: one weapon attack.

definitions.name: Rune Knight
definitions.summary: Fighter empowered by giant runes who can grow to giant size in battle.

definitions.name: Bonus Proficiencies
definitions.summary: Proficiency with smith's tools, and you learn Giant.

definitions.name: Rune Carver
definitions.summary: Inscribe runes you know (2, then 3 at 7th, 4 at 10th, 5 at 15th) on gear after a long rest. Each rune gives a passive benefit and can be invoked once per short or long rest (twice from 15th). Save DC 8 + proficiency bonus + Constitution modifier.

resources.name: Rune invocations (each rune once; twice from 15th)

actions.name: Invoke a rune
actions.note: Each rune has its own trigger and action cost. DC 8 + PB + CON.

definitions.name: Giant's Might
definitions.summary: Bonus action, proficiency bonus times per long rest: for 1 minute you become Large (if smaller), have advantage on Strength checks and saves, and once per turn add 1d6 to a weapon or unarmed hit (1d8 at 10th, 1d10 at 18th).

actions.name: Giant's Might
actions.note: Large for 1 minute, advantage on Strength checks and saves, extra damage once per turn.

definitions.name: Runic Shield
definitions.summary: Reaction when a creature you can see within 60 feet hits someone else: force the attacker to reroll and use the new roll. Proficiency bonus times per long rest.

actions.name: Runic Shield
actions.note: An attack hits another creature within 60 ft: the attacker rerolls the d20.

definitions.name: Great Stature
definitions.summary: You grow 3d4 inches permanently, and Giant's Might's extra damage becomes 1d8.

definitions.name: Master of Runes
definitions.summary: You can invoke each rune you know twice per short or long rest.

definitions.name: Runic Juggernaut
definitions.summary: Giant's Might's extra damage becomes 1d10, you can grow to Huge instead of Large, and your reach increases by 5 feet while enlarged.

definitions.name: Blind Fighting
definitions.summary: Blindsight out to 10 feet.

definitions.name: Interception
definitions.summary: Reaction when a creature you can see hits someone else within 5 feet of you: reduce the damage by 1d10 + your proficiency bonus. Needs a shield or a simple or martial weapon in hand.

actions.name: Interception
actions.note: Another creature within 5 ft is hit: reduce the damage. Shield or weapon in hand.

definitions.name: Superior Technique
definitions.summary: Learn one Battle Master maneuver and gain one d6 superiority die (back on a short or long rest), added to any you already have.

actions.name: Maneuver (Superior Technique)
actions.note: Spend the d6 on your chosen maneuver. Save DC 8 + PB + STR or DEX.

definitions.name: Thrown Weapon Fighting
definitions.summary: Draw a thrown weapon as part of the attack, and +2 damage on ranged attacks made with a thrown weapon.

definitions.name: Unarmed Fighting
definitions.summary: Unarmed strikes deal 1d6 + Strength bludgeoning (1d8 with no weapon or shield in hand). At the start of your turn, deal 1d4 bludgeoning to a creature you're grappling.

actions.name: Grapple damage (Unarmed Fighting)
actions.note: Start of your turn: a creature you're grappling takes the roll as bludgeoning damage.

definitions.name: Fighting Style
definitions.summary: Pick one fighting style; Tasha's Fighting Style Options add Blind Fighting, Interception, Superior Technique, Thrown Weapon Fighting and Unarmed Fighting.

definitions.name: Additional Fighting Style
definitions.summary: Pick a second fighting style (Tasha's options included).

definitions.name: Martial Versatility
definitions.summary: When you gain an Ability Score Improvement, you can swap your fighting style for another fighter style, or one maneuver for another if you're a Battle Master.
